jobs.prompt: A 1536x1024 sprite sheet laid out as a strict 2-column by 4-row grid of eight equal cells, read left to right then top to bottom, showing one effect across eight animation frames: 1 anticipation, 2 release, 3 travel, 4 travel, 5 pre-contact, 6 contact peak, 7 reaction, 8 dissipation. Hand-painted storybook game VFX with dark confident outlines and restrained afterglow, matching the rendering, line weight and cell framing of the reference sheet exactly. The effect body only: no characters, no creatures, no scenery, no floor, no UI, no text, no numbers, no frame borders. Every cell sits on the same flat uniform cyan chroma background for keying. Critical: the effect itself must contain no cyan, aqua, turquoise or pale sky-blue anywhere, so it stays clearly separable from the cyan background when the background is keyed out. IMPORTANT - this is a translucent SECOND layer that will be composited on top of another effect at about 25% opacity and slightly enlarged. Keep every shape BROAD, SIMPLE and OPEN, with large clear silhouettes and generous empty space; fine filigree, small sparkles and thin scratchy lines vanish completely at that opacity. It must read as a MATERIAL and a MOOD washing over the scene, never as a second attack of its own. Keep the saturation gentle - the runtime tints this layer again. Even the final dissipation frame must still show a clearly visible shape, never fade to nothing. The layer is a wide golden radiance with a heart-shaped halo opening through it. Frame 1 a warm glow gathers low and broad. Frames 2-4 it swells outward as a soft open wash with a single large heart-shaped ring rising through its middle. Frame 6 the wash reaches its widest and the heart halo sits fully open and bright. Frames 7-8 the halo softens and the wash sinks. Palette: warm gold and honey, soft rose, cream. No blue of any kind. The inside of the heart halo must be filled with solid warm gold as well, not left open or hollow. CRITICAL PAINTING NOTE: paint every part of this sheet FULLY OPAQUE with solid, confident colour and a clean hard silhouette edge. Do NOT paint it as a faint, see-through, airbrushed or feathered glow - the translucency is applied later by the engine, not by you. Any soft see-through area lets the cyan background mix into the artwork and the result keys out as a dirty grey-green stain. No cyan, teal or grey-green may appear anywhere inside or along the edge of the shape.
